FisherPoseImage.description: Outputs a mannequin pose image and prompt without CLIP or VAE. Use with any image-editing workflow, including Qwen Image 2511. Connect the mannequin to image1 and the full character photo to image2; use image3 only for the second individual photo. Prompts follow the character count and can be customized in the editor.

FisherQwenFreePose.description: Free posing for 1–2 characters with Qwen Image 2.1 and the VNCCS_QI2_PoseStudio LoRA. Mannequin = image1; character photo = image2. Group mode uses the full photo and supports swapping character assignments. Use reference_image_2 (image3) only for two individual photos. Set mannequin size in the editor; width and height on this node control the final output independently.

image.name: Front result
image.tooltip: The first-stage front result. The coarse render uses its dimensions.

camera_latent.name: Reconstruction camera latent
camera_latent.tooltip: Connect the latent from TripoSplat sampling. Its source camera calibrates rotation. Do not use the front image sampling latent.

FisherAnyAngleCamera.description: Applies the editor camera to a Gaussian splat and renders a coarse reference. For AnyAngle TextEncodeQwenImage21, connect the front result to image1, the coarse render to image2 and this prompt to prompt. Use CFG 1 and 25 steps.

enable_camera.name: Enable camera change
enable_camera.tooltip: Off: front pose only. On: run the full pipeline with the editor camera. Turning this off preserves the saved camera.

FisherShot.description: Stores the editor camera. Disable enable_camera for front-view pose generation only; enable it to resume the camera pipeline. The saved camera and front-stage generation settings are preserved.

FisherPoseResult.description: Selects the final result using the saved editor camera. Front view uses the front result; camera rotation automatically uses the new view.

use_default_template.name: Use default expansion template
use_default_template.tooltip: Use the default prompt expansion system template. When disabled, keep only the JSON output format requirements.

FisherQwenPose.description: For Qwen Image 2.1. Connect 1–3 reference images in order. The mannequin is appended as the last image. Auto mapping shares image 1 for a group photo, or maps separate photos in character order. Editor uploads assist posing only and do not replace these inputs.

FisherPoseStudio.description: Pose and position 1–3 characters with a shared camera. Connect the prompt to prompt, the framed mannequin image to image_2, and the original image to image_1. In camera-only mode, leave the pose image disconnected.

vision_source.name: Vision encoder
vision_source.tooltip: Select the matching mmproj F16 GGUF or the vision component of the full Qwen3-VL-8B safetensors model.
